title: Day 589 Mañanera: Olinia EV Launch Set for June 7; Chilapa Indigenous Hostages Confirmed Safe; NYT Bomb-Attack Allegations Rejected; Bienestar Housing Target Raised to 60,000
detail: On May 13, 2026 (Day 589), President Claudia Sheinbaum held her Wednesday Mañanera del Pueblo from the National Palace in Mexico City, covering six major topics. (1) OLINIA ELECTRIC VEHICLE LAUNCH: Sheinbaum confirmed June 7, 2026 as the official public launch date for Olinia, Mexico's first federally-supported domestic electric vehicle prototype, developed over 18 months by more than 80 Mexican academics and engineers led by Roberto Capuano. Specifications: 100% electric, maximum speed 50 km/h, designed for urban use. A cargo variant (Olinia de Carga) will be presented in July, with manufacturing to begin August–September 2026 at a target of 2,000 units per year. New federal regulations for low/medium-speed urban EVs are being drafted targeting readiness by 2027. Notably, Olinia will be used during the opening ceremony of the 2026 FIFA World Cup at Azteca Stadium on June 11 — days after its launch. (2) CHILAPA, GUERRERO SECURITY UPDATE: Sheinbaum confirmed that approximately 100 indigenous people previously detained or displaced by criminal violence perpetrated by Los Ardillos in Chilapa, Guerrero were confirmed safe. SEGOB (Interior Ministry) is coordinating an ongoing response for displaced communities. This followed the Day 588 Martes de Seguridad disclosure that 800+ families had been forced from their homes in Guerrero's Montaña Baja region. (3) NYT BOMB-ATTACK ALLEGATIONS DENIED: Sheinbaum firmly rejected a New York Times investigative article that alleged the Mexican government had used bomb attacks to eliminate criminal groups, calling the claims 'fictions' and reaffirming the administration's commitment to truth in public communication. The denial adds to ongoing US media–Mexican government tensions. (4) CHIHUAHUA/CIA INVESTIGATION: Sheinbaum addressed the unauthorized CIA field operations in Chihuahua — in which two CIA agents died in an April 20 crash returning from an unsanctioned joint drug-lab demolition — stating that the matter involves violations of national security law and the Mexican Constitution. Both the Chihuahua State Prosecutor's Office and the FGR (federal AG) are formally investigating. (5) BIENESTAR HOUSING PROGRAM (TABASCO): Via remote presentation from Tabasco, 64 Bienestar social housing units were delivered to families. The original national Bienestar housing target of 44,500 units was raised to 60,000 — representing a 34.8% expansion of the social housing program. Sheinbaum also indicated she would instruct Social Welfare Secretary Leticia Ramírez to review indigenous community registration with INPI (National Institute of Indigenous Peoples) to improve access to government economic support programs. (6) NAVY ARTIFICIAL REEF — TAMPICO: In a distinct government action, Admiral Raymundo Pedro Morales of SEMAR (Navy) sank a vessel named 'Onjuku' off the coast of Tampico, Tamaulipas, to create an artificial reef — attended by Tamaulipas Governor Américo Villarreal and SEMARNAT Secretary Alicia Bárcena. Officials confirmed no environmental risk from the controlled sinking.

media.caption: Sheinbaum's May 13 mañanera: Olinia EV launch set for June 7, Chilapa indigenous hostages confirmed safe, NYT bomb allegations rejected, Bienestar housing target raised to 60,000
Olinia — Mexico's federally-backed domestic electric vehicle — confirmed for official June 7 public launch; 80+ Mexican engineers and academics built the prototype over 18 months
